newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -GILTS TO DRIFT LOWER BUT 114-17 TO HOLD.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -GILTS TO DRIFT LOWER BUT 114-17 TO HOLD.

text.p: LIFFE September gilt futures will look to the downside on Friday after sharp gains in the previous session, but are not expected to slip below a buying area on Thursday between 114-24 and 114-17, technical analysts said.
"We are looking for a bit more reaction from yesterday's high," said Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London.
She noted support levels down to 114-24, 114-17 and said this area was the likely downside limit for the day.
At 0705 GMT, September gilt futures were at 114-31, down 6/32 on the day.
Whitby said initial support came from another buying area of late Thursday around 115-03.

"But if that gives way, which is a risk, we are looking for 114-29 to 27, the upper levels of a little base formed between August 1 and yesterday morning," she said, adding that there was the possibility of further drift.
To the upside, Whitby said there was some resistance around 115-16, a selling area on Thursday and above there 115-19 would come into play.
"We dropped quite quickly off the resistance yesterday and that 115-19, 115-25 area is quite formidable," said Whitby.
At the short end, December short sterling was at 92.68, down one basis point on the day.
